items.text: How often do you find it difficult to follow complex spoken instructions or meetings without written notes?
How easily do you grasp sarcasm, idioms, and figurative expressions in everyday discussions?
How often do you struggle to retrieve common words or names during conversation (tip-of-the-tongue phenomenon)?
How effectively do you express your thoughts using precise vocabulary?
How often do you find yourself structuring sentences simply to avoid grammatical confusion?
How comfortably do you construct complex sentences when writing professional emails or reports?
How often do you find it challenging to organize and summarize lengthy explanations or stories?
How easily can you recount a sequence of events or explain a process clearly to others?
How often do you misread conversational cues or feel out of sync in fast-paced group chats?
How comfortably do you participate in casual or professional networking conversations?
How often do you ask people to repeat themselves in noisy environments like restaurants?
How frequently do speech clarity or pronunciation concerns affect your confidence in public speaking?
How often do written workplace communications require extra time and effort for you to decode?
How often do you avoid social interactions or meetings due to anxiety about verbal expression?
How well do you adapt your register and tone when communicating with diverse audiences?
How often do you notice sudden, unexplained difficulties in your language or memory processing?
How comfortably do you navigate multiple languages in daily life, if applicable?
How often do grammatical or structural errors slip into your written work without you noticing?
How easily do you maintain the thread of a discussion when multiple people are talking?
How often do you rely heavily on outlines or templates to structure spoken presentations?

risk.low: No strong signs noticed in this check
risk.some_signs: Some signs worth keeping an eye on
risk.high: Several signs that may be worth discussing with a speech-language professional
risk.not_enough_info: We need a few more answers to provide a profile
